title: 2026-11-04_Linux_P2P_Ransom_Botnet_Investigation_d31
description: Investigate a Linux P2P Ransom botnet attack, identify indicators of compromise, and mitigate the threat.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The victim machine was attacked by the Linux P2P Ransom botnet malware. The attackers encrypted some files and left a ransom note behind. Your task is to investigate the attack, identify the indicators of compromise, and take appropriate actions to mitigate the threat.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the victim machine with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.
levels.local_content:
You have SSH access to the victim machine with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation

levels.title: Identify C2 Server Port
levels.content: The attackers encrypted some files and left a ransom note behind. Read this note and identify the C2 server port number.
levels.solution:
1. SSH into the victim machine using the provided credentials.
2. Navigate to the home directory of the user cyrano.
3. Read the contents of the file `RANSOM_NOTE.txt`.
4. Identify the C2 server port number mentioned in the ransom note.

hints.title: SSH into the victim machine
hints.content:
Use the `ssh` command to connect to the victim machine.
```
ssh cyrano@192.168.90.10
```

hints.title: Navigate to the home directory
hints.content:
Navigate to the home directory using the `cd` command.
```
cd /home/cyrano
```

hints.title: Read the ransom note
hints.content:
Read the contents of the ransom note using the `cat` command.
```
cat RANSOM_NOTE.txt
```

levels.title: Identify Ransomware Script
levels.content: The attacker left the ransomware script describing different steps performed by the ransomware malware. Identify this script.
levels.solution:
1. SSH into the victim machine using the provided credentials.
2. Navigate to the `/tmp` directory.
3. Look for hidden files using the `ls -la` command.
4. Identify the ransomware script.

hints.title: SSH into the victim machine
hints.content:
Use the `ssh` command to connect to the victim machine.
```
ssh cyrano@192.168.90.10
```

hints.title: Navigate to the /tmp directory
hints.content:
Navigate to the `/tmp` directory using the `cd` command.
```
cd /tmp
```

hints.title: Look for hidden files
hints.content:
Look for hidden files using the `ls -la` command.
```
ls -la
```

levels.title: Identify Exfiltration Destination
levels.content: Analyze the script identified in the previous step to find the remote destination used to send files to the exfiltration server.
levels.solution:
1. SSH into the victim machine using the provided credentials.
2. Navigate to the `/tmp` directory.
3. Read the contents of the ransomware script using the `cat` command.
4. Identify the remote destination used for exfiltration.

```

```
